teaser: Agents built four iOS apps from one workspace and an Android tablet app in five days, with TestFlight on every push and a signed build in four hours.
core_idea: Around Web Summit, agents grew a 1,164-line iPhone app into four iOS apps sharing 13 packages and 48,230 lines of Swift in five days, with TestFlight on every push, and built an Android tablet app from nothing to a signed build in 4 h 11 (33,042 lines of Kotlin, on-device Gemma, stand mode), plus a fringe guide from brief to TestFlight in about 10.5 hours. The constraint moved to Macs and review queues.
